@@
---  Winner tree with the keys at the leaves and one cached winner at every
---  internal node. Updating a leaf replays only its path to the root.
+--  Min-max tournament tree with the keys at the leaves and both extrema
+--  cached at every internal node. Updating a leaf replays only its path to
+--  the root.
@@
       Last        : Extended_Index := 0;
       Keys        : Key_Array (1 .. Capacity);
       Winners     : Winner_Array (1 .. Capacity) := [others => 0];
       Winner_Keys : Winner_Key_Array (1 .. Capacity);
+      Max_Winners : Winner_Array (1 .. Capacity) := [others => 0];
+      Max_Keys     : Winner_Key_Array (1 .. Capacity);
@@
    function Key_At (H : Heap; Node : Tree_Index) return Key_Type is
@@
                  and then Position_At (H, Node) > 0;
+
+   function Max_Position_At
+     (H : Heap; Node : Tree_Index) return Extended_Index is
+     (if Node < H.Capacity then H.Max_Winners (Node)
+      elsif Node - H.Capacity + 1 <= H.Last
+      then Node - H.Capacity + 1
+      else 0)
+     with Pre => H.Capacity > 0 and then Node <= 2 * H.Capacity - 1;
+
+   function Max_Key_At (H : Heap; Node : Tree_Index) return Key_Type is
+     (if Node < H.Capacity then H.Max_Keys (Node)
+      else H.Keys (Node - H.Capacity + 1))
+     with Pre => H.Capacity > 0
+                 and then Node <= 2 * H.Capacity - 1
+                 and then Max_Position_At (H, Node) > 0;
@@
-        (if LP = 0 then
+        (if LP = 0 then
             (if RP = 0 then H.Winners (Node) = 0
@@
          else
             H.Winners (Node) = RP
-              and then H.Winner_Keys (Node) = Key_At (H, Right)))
+              and then H.Winner_Keys (Node) = Key_At (H, Right))
+        and then
+        (declare
+            MLP : constant Extended_Index := Max_Position_At (H, Left);
+            MRP : constant Extended_Index := Max_Position_At (H, Right);
+         begin
+           (if MLP = 0 then
+               (if MRP = 0 then H.Max_Winners (Node) = 0
+                else H.Max_Winners (Node) = MRP
+                       and then H.Max_Keys (Node) = Max_Key_At (H, Right))
+            elsif MRP = 0 then
+               H.Max_Winners (Node) = MLP
+                 and then H.Max_Keys (Node) = Max_Key_At (H, Left)
+            elsif Max_Key_At (H, Left) >= Max_Key_At (H, Right) then
+               H.Max_Winners (Node) = MLP
+                 and then H.Max_Keys (Node) = Max_Key_At (H, Left)
+            else
+               H.Max_Winners (Node) = MRP
+                 and then H.Max_Keys (Node) = Max_Key_At (H, Right))))
@@
    function Is_Minimum (H : Heap; K : Key_Type) return Boolean is
@@
      with Ghost;
+
+   function Is_Maximum (H : Heap; K : Key_Type) return Boolean is
+     (for all I in 1 .. H.Last => H.Keys (I) <= K)
+     with Ghost;
@@
    function Root_Position (H : Heap) return Extended_Index is
@@
      with Pre => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H);
+
+   function Max_Root_Position (H : Heap) return Extended_Index is
+     (if H.Capacity = 1 then 1 else H.Max_Winners (1))
+     with Pre => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H);
@@
    function Peek_Min (H : Heap) return Key_Type
@@
                   and then Peek_Min'Result = H.Keys (Root_Position (H));
+
+   function Peek_Max (H : Heap) return Key_Type
+     with Pre  => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H),
+          Post => Is_Maximum (H, Peek_Max'Result)
+                  and then Peek_Max'Result = H.Keys (Max_Root_Position (H));
@@
    function Min_Of (H : Heap) return Key_Type
@@
                               Min_Of'Result = H.Keys (I));
+
+   function Max_Of (H : Heap) return Key_Type
+     with Pre  => not Is_Empty (H),
+          Post => Is_Maximum (H, Max_Of'Result)
+                  and then (for some I in 1 .. H.Last =>
+                              Max_Of'Result = H.Keys (I));
@@
    procedure Extract_Min (H : in out Heap; K : out Key_Type)
@@
                   and Model (H)'Old = Key_Multisets.Add (Model (H), K);
+
+   procedure Extract_Max (H : in out Heap; K : out Key_Type)
+     with Pre  => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H),
+          Post => Is_Heap (H)
+                  and Size (H) = Size (H)'Old - 1
+                  and K = Peek_Max (H)'Old
+                  and Is_Maximum (H'Old, K)
+                  and Model (H)'Old = Key_Multisets.Add (Model (H), K);
 
-end Heaps.Min_Max_Tournament;
+end Heaps.Min_Max_Tournament;

                   and (for all I in H.Winners'Range =>
                          (if I /= Node then
                             H.Winners (I) = H.Winners'Old (I)
-                            and H.Winner_Keys (I) = H.Winner_Keys'Old (I)));
+                            and H.Winner_Keys (I) = H.Winner_Keys'Old (I)

@@
       LP    : constant Extended_Index := Position_At (H, Left);
       RP    : constant Extended_Index := Position_At (H, Right);
+      MLP   : constant Extended_Index := Max_Position_At (H, Left);
+      MRP   : constant Extended_Index := Max_Position_At (H, Right);
@@
       else
          H.Winners (Node) := RP;
          H.Winner_Keys (Node) := Key_At (H, Right);
       end if;
+
+      if MLP = 0 then
+         if MRP = 0 then
+            H.Max_Winners (Node) := 0;
+         else
+            H.Max_Winners (Node) := MRP;
+            H.Max_Keys (Node) := Max_Key_At (H, Right);
+         end if;
+      elsif MRP = 0
+        or else Max_Key_At (H, Left) >= Max_Key_At (H, Right)
+      then
+         H.Max_Winners (Node) := MLP;
+         H.Max_Keys (Node) := Max_Key_At (H, Left);
+      else
+         H.Max_Winners (Node) := MRP;
+         H.Max_Keys (Node) := Max_Key_At (H, Right);
+      end if;
@@
                     (for all I in After.Winners'Range =>
                        (if I /= Changed then
                           After.Winners (I) = Before.Winners (I)
-                          and After.Winner_Keys (I) = Before.Winner_Keys (I))),
+                          and After.Winner_Keys (I) = Before.Winner_Keys (I)
+                          and After.Max_Winners (I) = Before.Max_Winners (I)
+                          and After.Max_Keys (I) = Before.Max_Keys (I))),
@@
                   and then
                     (if Position_At (After, 2 * Node + 1) > 0 then
                        Key_At (After, 2 * Node + 1)
-                         = Key_At (Before, 2 * Node + 1)),
+                         = Key_At (Before, 2 * Node + 1))
+                  and then Max_Position_At (After, Node)
+                             = Max_Position_At (Before, Node)
+                  and then Max_Position_At (After, 2 * Node)
+                             = Max_Position_At (Before, 2 * Node)
+                  and then Max_Position_At (After, 2 * Node + 1)
+                             = Max_Position_At (Before, 2 * Node + 1)
+                  and then
+                    (if Max_Position_At (After, Node) > 0 then
+                       Max_Key_At (After, Node) = Max_Key_At (Before, Node))
+                  and then
+                    (if Max_Position_At (After, 2 * Node) > 0 then
+                       Max_Key_At (After, 2 * Node)
+                         = Max_Key_At (Before, 2 * Node))
+                  and then
+                    (if Max_Position_At (After, 2 * Node + 1) > 0 then
+                       Max_Key_At (After, 2 * Node + 1)
+                         = Max_Key_At (Before, 2 * Node + 1)),
@@
                   and then Before.Winners = After.Winners
                   and then Before.Winner_Keys = After.Winner_Keys
+                  and then Before.Max_Winners = After.Max_Winners
+                  and then Before.Max_Keys = After.Max_Keys
                   and then
                     (for all Node in After.Capacity .. 2 * After.Capacity - 1 =>
                        (if Node /= Leaf then
                           Position_At (After, Node) = Position_At (Before, Node)
                           and then
                             (if Position_At (After, Node) > 0 then
-                               Key_At (After, Node) = Key_At (Before, Node)))),
+                               Key_At (After, Node) = Key_At (Before, Node))
+                          and then Max_Position_At (After, Node)
+                                     = Max_Position_At (Before, Node)
+                          and then
+                            (if Max_Position_At (After, Node) > 0 then
+                               Max_Key_At (After, Node)
+                                 = Max_Key_At (Before, Node)))),
@@
                     (for all I in After.Winners'Range =>
                        (if I /= Changed then
                           After.Winners (I) = Before.Winners (I)
-                          and After.Winner_Keys (I) = Before.Winner_Keys (I))),
+                          and After.Winner_Keys (I) = Before.Winner_Keys (I)
+                          and After.Max_Winners (I) = Before.Max_Winners (I)
+                          and After.Max_Keys (I) = Before.Max_Keys (I))),

@@
-   --  Destructive meld. The leaf runs are concatenated and both fixed-size
-   --  tournament arrays are rebuilt bottom-up, in O(Into.Capacity +
-   --  From.Capacity) time.
+   --  Destructive meld. The leaf runs are concatenated and the extrema
+   --  caches in both fixed-size trees are rebuilt bottom-up, in
+   --  O(Into.Capacity + From.Capacity) time.

@@
---  The min-max heap is measured twice: through the common driver, which only
---  uses the min end and therefore places it next to the single-ended heaps,
---  and through the double-ended driver, which is the workload it exists for.
+--  The min-max tournament is measured twice: through the common driver,
+--  which only uses the min end and therefore places it next to the
+--  single-ended heaps, and through the double-ended driver.
